_comment: Tornadoes that come down out of the Age's thunderstorms and tear across it (wind-plan 4). It means the
phenomenon outright, as `sandfall` does; the thunderstorms it needs come with it, more often than an ordinary Age has them.
It takes a size as its strength (Jonah): a tornado's width is its strength, so `colossal tornado` is the
strongest there is, `large` a strong one and `small` or `minuscule` a weak one, as `strong` and `weak` say it too.
